name: WPA 24x7 Green-Cycle Owner Release Gate
principle: No production victory is declared and no protected production merge is authorised until the hardened WPA 24x7 Institute Operations cycle has successfully exercised the governed chain from COLLECT through RIGHTS/SOURCE CHECK, WPA-NATIVE TRANSFORM, CHECK, PRODUCE and ADAPT on the current PR head, and the owner explicitly approves release.
core_rule_mk: WPA НЕ ГО ПРЕЗЕМА ТУЃОТО ЗНАЕЊЕ. WPA ГО ПРОВЕРУВА, ГО РАЗЛОЖУВА, ГО СООЧУВА СО СОПСТВЕНАТА ДОКТРИНА, ГО МЕРИ, ГО ПРЕИСПИТУВА И ОД НЕГО СОЗДАВА НОВА WPA ИНСТИТУЦИОНАЛНА ВРЕДНОСТ.
required_preconditions: The relevant WPA 24x7 Institute Operations workflow run is completed with conclusion=success.
The successful run is anchored to the current PR #261 head SHA, not an obsolete feature commit.
PR #261 remains open, mergeable and not already merged.

Open-knowledge rights/source controls remain fail-closed: no paywall/login/CAPTCHA bypass, no protected full-text copying, metadata-only sources remain discovery-only until a lawful substantive basis is verified, and public institutional portal bodies are not retained as WPA content.
WPA-native transformation remains source-attributed, protected-source-body-free and passes the anti-copy overlap gate.
Journal Watch remains EDITORIAL_INTELLIGENCE_HUMAN_GOVERNED with automatic scientific article generation/publication and automatic peer-review decisions disabled.
Protocolometry measurement guardrails pass and no autonomous ordinal ranking is introduced.
Owner approval queue continues to report automatic_production_merge=DISABLED and automatic_external_publishing=DISABLED.
No unresolved failed required check is treated as green.

owner_command.meaning: Explicit Human Authority approval to apply the already-reviewed PR #261 operating-system package to main, but only after all release preconditions are re-verified immediately before merge.
not_authorised_by_phrase: reuse outside the explicitly approved scope

merge_rule: The approval phrase is necessary but not sufficient by itself: immediately before merge, current PR head, required checks and green full-cycle evidence must be re-read. If the head moved or a required check failed/pended, the gate remains closed and the owner is told why.
post_merge_rule: After merge, production-live status is asserted only after the applicable main-branch checks/deployment evidence succeed; merge success alone is not proof of live deployment.
